_comment: THE INVARIANT POPULATION -- 50 fabricated case names that resolve to no document. The correct answer for every row is an empty page.
Every caption is invented and its parties were checked against the corpus at build time; a proposal that resolved to a real document was dropped rather than emitted.

This tier reports a false-positive rate and never a hit rate, and it is excluded from the headline by construction. It exists so the cost of answering loosely is priced rather than assumed: a backend that suppresses uncertain answers scores well on any hit rate and is worse to use.
